nodes.label: Blueprint-First Code Generation
nodes.rationale: Builder must consult Librarian before generating code to enforce architectural consistency and prevent hallucinated patterns; falls back to native generation only when no blueprint exists

nodes.label: Gem Registry — Context7 IDs × Architectural Roles
nodes.norm_label: gem registry — context7 ids × architectural roles

nodes.label: Convention Target Detection
nodes.rationale: Convention target detection inspects .rubocop.yml, standard in Gemfile, .rubysmith config, or community idioms to determine which Ruby style/lint rules to enforce during analysis and refactoring.

nodes.label: Standard Mode Conventions
nodes.rationale: Standard Mode is the rubysmithing convention set for multi-file or gem-dependent Ruby projects: frozen_string_literal, Zeitwerk paths, journald-logger, Async {}, circuit_breaker on external calls.

nodes.label: Lite Mode Conventions
nodes.rationale: Lite Mode applies to stdlib-only code under 50 lines — no namespacing mandates, simplified conventions.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker Pattern
nodes.rationale: Circuit breaker is required on remote embedding API calls in Standard Mode to prevent cascade failures. Not required for local informers inference.

nodes.label: Frozen String Literal Pragma
nodes.rationale: frozen_string_literal: true is a Standard Mode requirement reducing string object allocation overhead. Applied to all generated Ruby files.

nodes.label: Content Hash Idempotency (SHA256)
nodes.rationale: SHA256 content_hash on every text-bearing table ensures idempotent inserts — re-ingesting the same content produces the same hash and is rejected by unique constraint.

nodes.label: Systemic Functional Linguistics (SFL)
nodes.rationale: SFL provides the canonical schema structure: process_type enum (6 types), participant roles (polymorphic set), three metafunctions (ideational, interpersonal, textual) encoded as JSONB columns with dry-schema validation.

nodes.label: Embedding Dimension Locking
nodes.rationale: Embedding dimension must be locked before writing migrations: informers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2=384, nomic-embed-text-v1=768, ruby_llm/OpenAI=1536. Default to 384 for local inference. Never mix dimensions in same table.

nodes.label: Transactional Outbox Pattern
nodes.rationale: For Neo4j dual-write: graph_sync_outbox table with event_type/payload/status, atomic Sequel transaction wraps clause insert + outbox event, Neo4j worker uses MERGE not CREATE for idempotency.

nodes.label: HNSW Vector Index Strategy
nodes.rationale: HNSW indexes required on every embedding column with vector_cosine_ops for approximate nearest neighbor search. Chosen over IVFFlat for dynamic datasets without retraining.

nodes.label: GIN JSONB Index Strategy
nodes.rationale: GIN indexes required on every JSONB column used in filter queries (ideational_structure, interpersonal_structure, textual_structure, register_metadata) for efficient JSON containment and existence operators.

nodes.label: Verified Context Block
nodes.rationale: Verified Context Blocks are the ground truth for gem API calls — they contain verified method signatures and usage examples resolved via Context7 or SQLite cache, preventing hallucinated API usage.

nodes.label: SADD Tree of Thoughts Pattern
nodes.rationale: Tree of Thoughts explores 3 parallel branches per dimension (What/Who/Value), scores each branch, prunes the lowest scorer, and synthesizes surviving branches into a Project Charter.
